justification: Function only reads a single boolean flag from user-supplied structure with no risky operations or memory handling.
analysis: The function reads from info->bypass which is part of the xt_NFQ_info_v2 structure passed in par->targinfo. This structure is user-supplied through netfilter rules and contains attacker-influenced data. The function performs a simple boolean check on this value without additional validation or bounds checking. No memory allocation, copying, or freeing occurs in this function.
